title: Vuln Horizon sketch notes — weekly tactical
content:
Meeting: Vulnerability horizon sketch — weekly tactical checkin
Date: 2027-03-08
Attendees: Priya, Miguel, Hannah, Samir, Evelyn (10 people dialed but core listed)
Goal: quick triage for high-priority findings, align secrets rotation runway, and surface any emerging attack patterns for the threat-model workshop next Tue

TL;DR:
- Two new findings from fuzzing pipeline: one medium-risk deserialization bug in the stats ingestion path (SEC-1124), one low-risk SSO token leakage pattern in old staging job. Priority: fix ingestion path first.
- Secrets rotation: we have a plan for ephemeral worker tokens but need rollout window and feature-flag for rollback.
- Threat modeling: focus on model-weight exfil vector and cached-KV poisoning. Run tabletop with platform-eng next week.

Notes (choppy, raw):
- SEC-1124: ingestion deserialization (media): fuzz-run flagged proto parsing with unvalidated map keys. CVSS-ish impact: medium (data exposure + DoS potential under crafted payload). Owner: Miguel. Short-term mitigation: strip unknown map entries at gateway + killchain rule in WAF. Long-term: patch proto parser and add a fuzz harness CI gate.
  - ETA for gate + hotfix: Miguel estimates 3 business days for hotfix + 5 days to full parser hardening.
  - Jira: SEC-1124 linked; assign to mgonzalez (Miguel)
  - PR for temporary sanitizer: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/488 (WIP)

- Staging SSO token leakage: observed in old nightly-job that writes debug metadata to a log bucket (legacy). Low severity — tokens are short-lived but replayable for ~10m. Owner: Hannah. Action: rotate staging KMS keys and remove token dump in job. Also add CI lint to prevent printing creds.
  - Quick patch scheduled tonight, rotation window proposed 03/09 02:00-03:00 UTC. Hannah to coordinate with infra.

- Secrets rotation & ephemeral tokens discussion:
  - Problem: long-lived worker tokens across Dedicated pools increase blast radius.
  - Proposal: adopt ephemeral tokens minted by auth-service for GPU workers with TTL 15m + refresh via secure sidecar. Sidecar will authenticate to KMS for bootstrapping only.
  - Concerns: increased auth-service load and latency for cold starts. Samir to run load sims and determine queueing/backpressure behavior.
  - Feature-flag plan: roll out ephemeral tokens behind ff_ephemeral_tokens and a fallback to existing tokens. Must include automated rollback path if >1% auth failures observed.

- Threat modeling prep notes (for 03/16 tabletop):
  - Focus area 1: model-weight exfil via crafted prompts + side-channel from multitenant shared caches. Hypotheses: repeated prefix queries + cache timing/eviction signals can be used to infer weights or KV store contents.
  - Focus area 2: KV cache poisoning to induce incorrect completions (integrity attack).
  - Focus area 3: supply-chain risk from third-party quantization toolchains (we need SBOM and pinned hashes).
  - Prep asks: have a short deck with attack scenarios, any recent anomaly traces (observability team), and a list of critical models/pools (prod vs dedicated vs private). Evelyn to assemble deck + list by EOD 03/12.

- Observability gaps called out:
  - We currently lack per-token timing metrics exposed to sec team (only aggregated per-route). Need short-term sampling pipeline that captures 1% of requests with token timing + cache hit metadata. Product to approve retention policy.
  - Error classification: several 502s from inference runtime map to generic infra alerts; add sec-specific tagging for any errors that originate from deserialization/parsing code paths.

Action items (owners + dates):
- Miguel: push sanitizer hotfix PR and schedule WAF rule by 03/11 (SEC-1124).
- Hannah: rotate staging keys and remove token dumps tonight (03/09) + add CI lint for prints by 03/12.
- Samir: run auth-service load sims for ephemeral token plan and share results by 03/15.
- Evelyn: draft threat-model tabletop deck + critical-model-list by 03/12.
- Priya: coordinate with product for short-term sampling approval + draft retention policy by 03/11.

Open questions / Parking lot:
- How do Dedicated customers feel about ephemeral tokens? Need to surface to Platform PM before rolling out. (Priya)
- Is there a quick way to detect KV cache poisoning besides anomaly rates? Memo: consider checksum-based guards on cached outputs. (Samir)
- Regulatory: Private deployments with air-gapped infra — do we need a different secrets rotation cadence? Legal to advise. (Evelyn to flag)

Random notes to self (unstructured):
- Slack threads: #sec-triage, #infra-nightly (link snippets to SEC-1124 thread)
- Add a short playbook entry: "hotfix -> WAF -> parser-hotpatch -> fuzz-gate" with explicit rollback steps. Save under Confluence page: Vuln Triage Playbook (link above).
- Consider running a red-team micro-run against the ingestion path after hotfix (1 week post-deploy).

Next meeting: 2027-03-15 09:30 PT (weekly) — focus after tabletop will be postmortem and rollout plan for ephemeral tokens.

End notes: doc is intentionally terse — will expand into confluence playbook entry once hotfix behavior validated.
